authority_inconsistencies.description: The accepted vertical-slice design names scripts/world.gd::_exit_tree as a frozen function authority. The exact frozen Git object must determine whether the file and symbol exist; no symbol may be inferred.
authority_inconsistencies.interim_rule: If scripts/world.gd exists at the frozen commit, protect its exact bytes. Do not claim _exit_tree exists.

authority_inconsistencies.description: The initial G0 contract copied SHA-256 values from the reconstructed composite authority and incorrectly treated them as exact PR #59 Git-tree hashes.
authority_inconsistencies.resolution: Protection now compares exact Git objects at the frozen commit. Generated census evidence will record exact blob SHA and SHA-256 values.
